scenes.title: François's Rehearsal
scenes.summary: Andréa describes her pairing of François Berléand with young director Christophe Bel. At the theatre rehearsal, Christophe directs from a desk and urges François to try the inflatable duck, but the actor refuses.
scenes.location: Theatre meeting area and rehearsal hall with indoor swimming pool

scenes.title: Catherine's Visit
scenes.summary: Camille is speaking to her mother when Catherine arrives unexpectedly at her studio. Camille tries to put the visitor at ease, while Catherine wants to understand the family secret; a question about drinks briefly causes a misunderstanding.
scenes.location: Camille's studio apartment and entrance courtyard

scenes.title: The Truth About Mathias
scenes.summary: Catherine questions Camille about her childhood visits from Mathias and her age. Back at the family home, Catherine orders Mathias to leave; afterwards he asks their son Hippolyte to look after his mother.
scenes.location: Camille's studio; the Barneville family home and street outside

scenes.title: I Can't Swim
scenes.summary: At ASK, François demands that Andréa remove the pool from the production. When she presses him to explain his refusal, he finally admits that he does not know how to swim.
scenes.location: Andréa's office at ASK

scenes.title: An Audition for Luc Besson!
scenes.summary: Gabriel offers Sofia an audition for a Luc Besson film with a supporting role and a generous fee. Sofia accepts the opportunity while concealing that she cannot meet its hip-hop dance requirement.
scenes.location: ASK reception desk

scenes.title: Jean Gabin, Get Out of There!
scenes.summary: Noémie and Hervé speculate that Mathias's bag contains money for the agency buyout. Noémie snoops while Hervé keeps watch, and Arlette's dog Jean Gabin disrupts them by damaging the cash.
scenes.location: ASK corridor and Mathias's office

scenes.title: The Inflatable Duck
scenes.summary: At Andréa's office, Christophe explains why the inflatable duck matters to him. Andréa insists François may stay out of the water and warns Christophe against replacing his star just before opening night.
scenes.location: Andréa's office at ASK

scenes.title: If I Hadn't Come to Paris
scenes.summary: Camille worries that moving to Paris has damaged Mathias's family and the agency buyout. She considers calling rival agent Dominique Besnehard about an assistant job.
scenes.location: ASK open floor near Mathias's office

scenes.title: The Punch
scenes.summary: A rehearsal argument ends with Christophe accidentally knocking François into the pool. François climbs out and punches the director, putting the production in jeopardy.
scenes.location: Theatre rehearsal stage and indoor swimming pool

scenes.title: The Threat of a Lawsuit
scenes.summary: The theatre director threatens legal action after the rehearsal fight. Andréa worries about the production and the agency's reputation, Camille suggests a goodwill discount, and Camille then calls Hippolyte about his contracts.
scenes.location: Andréa's office at ASK and telephone calls

scenes.title: Our Father
scenes.summary: Hippolyte avoids visiting ASK while Mathias is there, so Camille meets him at a café to handle his contracts. The half-siblings discuss their father and agree to become friends.
scenes.location: Telephone call and Paris café

scenes.title: François's Swimming Pool
scenes.summary: Andréa visits François at home and discovers that he is having a swimming pool dug so he can learn to swim. She encourages him to return to the play and phones Christophe to arrange dinner.
scenes.location: François's house and garden; Andréa's telephone call

scenes.title: The Work Dinner
scenes.summary: Andréa arranges dinner with Christophe, persuades Colette to stay at her apartment and gives her a toothbrush. Later, over dinner with Andréa, Christophe invites her to his birthday party.
scenes.location: Telephone call, Andréa's apartment and Paris restaurant

scenes.title: A Message for Berléand
scenes.summary: Andréa uses Christophe's phone to send François a birthday invitation in his name. At home, Colette objects to Andréa's late return and insists on an evening with her friends.
scenes.location: Paris restaurant and Andréa's apartment

scenes.title: Sofia's Audition
scenes.summary: Sofia arrives for a film audition and introduces herself. Asked to begin with choreography, she performs an improvised action scene instead.
scenes.location: Casting studio

scenes.title: The Truth About the Audition
scenes.summary: Constance interrupts Sofia's improvised performance and asks for the dance. After the audition goes wrong, Gabriel confronts Sofia at ASK; she admits she cannot dance hip-hop and challenges his stereotyped assumptions about her.
scenes.location: Casting studio and Gabriel's office at ASK

scenes.title: I Will Never Forgive You
scenes.summary: Mathias asks Catherine for a chance to apologize while she is at a hair salon, but she refuses forgiveness. Andréa later arranges to meet François at Christophe's birthday party and calls Colette about her changed work plans.
scenes.location: Hair salon and Andréa's telephone calls

scenes.title: A Last Drink at the Studio
scenes.summary: Andréa tells Colette she must take François to Christophe's party to rescue the production, while promising to join Colette's friends afterwards.
scenes.location: Andréa's apartment and journey to the rehearsal-studio party

scenes.title: François's Secret
scenes.summary: At Christophe's birthday party, François feels ignored and threatens to leave. Andréa tries to reconcile actor and director, then reveals that François does not know how to swim.
scenes.location: Christophe Bel's rehearsal-studio birthday party

scenes.title: Camille Meets Mathias at the Hotel
scenes.summary: At his hotel, Mathias leaves an anguished message for Catherine. Reception announces Camille's visit, and he invites his daughter to dinner.
scenes.location: Mathias's hotel room and reception telephone call

scenes.title: Star-Anise Tea
scenes.summary: At dinner, Camille recalls discovering cinema at her uncle's video shop and suggests star-anise tea for Mathias's stomach. Mathias asks whether she has called Dominique Besnehard and says Andréa would prefer her to stay at ASK.
scenes.location: Hotel restaurant and corridor outside Mathias's room

scenes.title: The Swimming Pool Trauma
scenes.summary: At a table during his birthday party, Christophe describes his own childhood pool accident in Spain. François connects the story to Dom Juan and argues against putting the character in the water; the inflatable duck remains a point of disagreement.
scenes.location: Birthday-party table in Christophe Bel's rehearsal studio

scenes.title: The Break-Up with Colette
scenes.summary: Andréa kisses another woman at the birthday party and ends up in the pool. Colette leaves, and Andréa follows her into the street to plead with her before Colette departs by taxi.
scenes.location: Rehearsal-studio birthday party and street outside

scenes.title: Sofia's Forgiveness and Andréa's Panic
scenes.summary: Sofia visits Gabriel at his apartment to apologize for their argument, and both accept responsibility. As they prepare to share a drink, a wet and distraught Andréa arrives and begs Gabriel to marry and protect her.
scenes.location: Gabriel's apartment entrance

scenes.title: The Psychoanalysis of Dom Juan
scenes.summary: After the performance, a male psychoanalyst discusses Dom Juan's fear of commitment with Andréa. He offers her a signed book and his phone number; Andréa says the dedication is enough.
scenes.location: Theatre foyer after the performance

scenes.title: The Return of Madame Brancillon
scenes.summary: Romantic script titles irritate Andréa after the breakup. She and Camille discuss Colette's absence before the tax inspector returns to ASK and walks past Andréa towards the conference room.
scenes.location: Andréa's office and ASK corridor

scenes.title: The Tax Audit Verdict
scenes.summary: Colette tells the ASK partners that company and family finances must be kept separate. She identifies personal expenses paid by the agency, announces a substantial fine and court proceedings, and rejects Gabriel's excuse about buying festival socks.
scenes.location: ASK conference room

scenes.title: Threat of Bankruptcy at ASK
scenes.summary: Hélène questions whether Mathias's wife and father-in-law will still fund the purchase of her shares after the audit. The discussion turns to bankruptcy and Mathias's separation from Catherine, while Andréa leaves to catch Colette.
scenes.location: ASK conference room and open floor

scenes.title: The Farewell Kiss
scenes.summary: In the street outside ASK, Andréa promises Colette an emotional commitment and asks for a chance to learn. Colette gives her a farewell kiss and leaves; afterwards Gabriel explains his own feelings about Andréa to Sofia.
scenes.location: Street outside ASK and agency window area

scenes.title: Samuel's Whiskey and the Movies
scenes.summary: The staff share Samuel's whisky and recall an old Cannes festival disappearance. Mathias, Andréa and Arlette trade remarks before everyone leaves; Arlette then reassures the group and invites Camille to find comfort in a trip to the cinema.
scenes.location: Samuel Kerr's office, street outside ASK and cinema outing
